detail: Get to 55 days of 55+ miles (about 30 now). One 55-miler a week gets you there around May 2027. Long rides are set to 55 mi so each one counts.
Climb it for the first time someday, as Colombier practice: steady seated efforts up the summit road. Check the park's bike hours first.
The next step up after Kennesaw: about 400 m of climbing in one go, a third of a Tourmalet. Plan it for a dry weekend in the climb-specific phase.
SRAM Force E1 XPLR power meter crank arm (left side, keeps your 40T). Match your crank length.
Shop fit, or DIY with an 8 mm hex key and a torque wrench. Pair it and run a zero offset.
Rain cost you three weekend rides in two weeks. A smart trainer or rollers turns rain days into Zone 2 or threshold sessions instead of zero.
20-minute test in the first week with the meter, then power targets get redone.
In the weekly plan now: tick each exercise off in the Strength card on Today.
On every 55-miler, eat every 30–45 min and drink about a bottle an hour, the same routine the 3–4 hour Alpine days need.
Every fourth week, cut volume by a third. Next one: Thanksgiving week, Nov 23–29.
Scan or photograph the photo page and save a copy offline on your phone and in Google Drive. While it's out, check it's valid until at least late October 2027.
